convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom with unknown indicator 'ColorRMACD' and two external .mqh includes (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh). The ColorRMACD indicator is not a built-in MT5 indicator, requiring manual Python reimplementation of the RMACD calculation logic.

derived_values.name: RMACD histogram (buffer 0)
derived_values.formula: ColorRMACD buffer 0: difference of fast RVI and slow TRVI moving averages using volume-weighted data
derived_values.used_by: entry/exit rule - breakdown, MACDtwist, MACDdisposition modes

derived_values.name: RMACD signal line (buffer 2)
derived_values.formula: ColorRMACD buffer 2: signal line smoothed from histogram using Signal_Method (SMA) with period Signal_XMA=9 and phase 100
derived_values.used_by: entry/exit rule - SIGNALtwist and MACDdisposition modes

other_exits: Long positions closed when sell signal generated (if BuyPosClose=true)
Short positions closed when buy signal generated (if SellPosClose=true)

params.description: MM=-0.1: negative values specify fixed lot size (0.1 lots), positive values specify share of deposit

position_sizing.conditional_logic: When MM<0, |MM| is used as fixed lot size; when MM>0, MM is fraction of deposit

custom_logic_notes: EA has 4 entry modes selectable via AlgMode enum: (1) breakdown - MACD histogram crosses zero; (2) MACDtwist - MACD histogram changes direction (3-bar comparison); (3) SIGNALtwist - signal line changes direction (3-bar comparison, uses buffer 2); (4) MACDdisposition - MACD histogram crosses signal line. SignalBar=1 means signals are read from the previous closed bar (not the current forming bar). The BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose booleans act as permission gates for opening/closing long/short positions. The ColorRMACD indicator uses RVI (Relative Vigor Index) as the fast component and TRVI as the slow component, combined into a MACD-style oscillator with a configurable smoothing method for the signal line (supports JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA beyond standard SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA).
backtest_data_needs: Any symbol H4 730 days with tick volume data
python_conversion_notes: Requires reimplementation of ColorRMACD indicator: fast RVI(12) minus slow TRVI(26) with volume weighting, plus signal line smoothing. The SmoothAlgorithms.mqh library provides 10+ smoothing methods beyond standard MAs - need to implement at least the selected method (SMA for signal line). TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides position open/close wrappers that handle lot sizing (MM negative=fixed lots, positive=deposit fraction), SL/TP placement, and deviation - these are standard order management patterns easily replicated in Python. The 4 entry modes are straightforward crossover/direction-change logic. SignalBar=1 shifts all signal reads by 1 bar (use previous closed bar for decisions), which naturally maps to next-bar-open backtest filling.
